title: Step nine normalizes exported paragraphs, proves icons and retains measured template backdrop colours
steps: Run the listed suites sequentially with Node 24. They execute the real write and checker code against fictional site fixtures and generated pictures.
expect: Paragraph-only and list values become safe HTML at HTML storage; ACM codes remain native and malformed markup is refused.
Correct body icon classes pass; missing, wrong, head-only and text-only representations fail.
An accent-only brand uses the original matching template backdrop's measured neutral; changed or unreadable pictures never supply a guessed colour.
Only a successfully closed matching form discharges its submit-label failure; shared controls and reopened forms still fail read-back.
fence: Storage-specific normalization, rendered icon semantics and measured per-recipe template neutral provenance

tests: paragraph-only HTML params normalize through the guard while native ACM paragraphs keep their codes
HTML list normalization preserves its template class and the rest of the record
unsupported paragraph attributes remain blocked and never become a site update
a text-valued icon slot needs its complete classes on a body icon element, not visible class words
the site check accepts a rendered icon and reports a missing glyph as an icon failure
an accent-only brand redraws a measured template backdrop in its actual neutral, without a colour module
a changed or unreadable template backdrop never supplies an invented surface colour
the write orchestration discharges a submit-label refusal only after its own form closes
a shared label still blocks when a different control remains on the page
